assertions.assertion: Client uses standard shared secret authentication (not certificate-based authentication)
assertions.rationale: hybrid_app keeps a hashed shared secret with no X509 certificate secret, and the prose emphasizes this.

assertions.assertion: Explains that the cnf claim with x5t#S256 will be embedded in the access token
assertions.rationale: It shows the access token gaining a `cnf` claim with an `x5t#S256` thumbprint value.

assertions.assertion: Mentions that the client must use a TLS client certificate when calling the token endpoint (even though the certificate is not used for authentication)
assertions.rationale: The response states the client must present a TLS client certificate at the token endpoint even though it is not used for authentication.
